answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12927 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum mufti sb., what to do if one recite surah after surah-fatiha in the 3rd or 4th rakah of any fard (compulsary) salaah (in both cases as being an Imam or performing individually)? will the sajda sahu will be sufficient in such case? Question: Assalamualikum mufti sb., what to do if one recite surah after surah-fatiha in the 3rd or 4th rakah of any fard (compulsary) salaah (in both cases as being an Imam or performing individually)? will the sajda sahu will be sufficient in such case? Answer ID: 12927 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 842/842=M/1430) It is against sunnah to recite any surah in third and fourth rak?ah of fardh after Surah Fatihah, one should not do so. But if someone does so, sajdah sahv will not be wajib: قال في المنية وشرحها فإن ضم السورة إلى الفاتحة ساهيا يجب عليه سجدتا السهو في قول أبي يوسف لتأخير الركوع عن محله وفي أظهر الروايات لا يجب لأن القراءة فيهما مشروعة من غير تقدير والاقتصار على الفاتحة مسنون لا واجب (شامي) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
